# Public regression fixtures

These three JSON files are author-written synthetic inputs for citation formatting, numeric verification and cross-language retrieval tests. Legacy filenames and test names retain their development lineage; they do not assert that these are original production sources or real provider outputs. IDs are deterministic sample UUIDs generated from example.org names. Diagnostic rejection fields are simulated pre-fix inputs, not newly measured results. No private knowledge-base export, historical request ID or long third-party source snapshot is included.
